description: nf-core/smrnaseq samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 2.4.1 schema. Small-RNA / miRNA sequencing.

mirtrace_species.help: miRTrace species code (hsa, mmu, mcc...). REQUIRED for a meaningful run — derive it from the cohort's organism.

mature.help: miRBase mature.fa. The upstream DEFAULT points at an nf-core TEST dataset, not real miRBase — leave null only if the curator accepts that.

hairpin.help: miRBase hairpin.fa; same test-data caveat as `mature`.

pipeline.name: nf-core/smrnaseq
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2. Only sample and fastq_1 are required; small-RNA libraries are usually single-end.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
sample must be non-empty; fastq_1 must be a gzipped FASTQ path.
Small-RNA libraries are usually single-end: leave fastq_2 blank unless the library really is paired.
Set mirtrace_species from the cohort organism — without it the miRNA QC output is not meaningful.
The upstream defaults for `mature`/`hairpin` point at an nf-core TEST miRBase subset. Do not present a run using them as a real miRBase analysis.
Do NOT pass --gtf: smrnaseq's schema has no gtf parameter.
notes: Small-RNA/miRNA quantification. bowtie_index is built from the FASTA when not supplied; the Luria refs tree has no prebuilt index, so expect an index build on first run per genome.

sources.label: nf-core/smrnaseq nextflow_schema.json @ 2.4.1
sources.notes: Authoritative param names, types and defaults for the pinned revision.

sources.label: nf-core/smrnaseq assets/schema_input.json @ 2.4.1
sources.notes: Authoritative required/optional samplesheet columns and allowed values.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/smrnaseq input samplesheet.

sample.description: Custom sample name; repeat across lanes of one library.
sample.validation_hints: Prefer the NExtSEEK D.SEQ UID so results map back to the sample record.

fastq_1.validation_hints: Absolute Luria path, taken from the sample's Link_PrimaryData / File_PrimaryData.

fastq_2.description: Read 2 FASTQ. Small-RNA is typically single-end — usually blank.
fastq_2.validation_hints: Blank for single-end; keep the header.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/smrnaseq samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort of small-RNA libraries.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected for miRNA / small-RNA sequencing cohorts.
population_priority: One row per D.SEQ leaf; sample = the UID.
Map R1 from the sample's primary-data metadata; leave fastq_2 blank unless genuinely paired.
Resolve mirtrace_species from the cohort organism and state it in the reply.
final_checks: mirtrace_species is set, or its absence is called out to the user.
The mature/hairpin test-data caveat has been surfaced if defaults were used.

required_user_params.name: mirtrace_species
required_user_params.definition: The miRTrace species code for this cohort's organism. Without it the miRNA QC output is not meaningful.
required_user_params.example: hsa   (human; mmu = mouse, mcc = rhesus macaque)
